title: UI风格#28 - Kinetic Concrete (动力混凝土)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kinetic Concrete style When color palette Then features concrete grays, bold accent colors, high contrast

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Bebas Neue (headers), Oswald (body), Space Mono (code)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kinetic Concrete style When layout Then kinetic typography, moving elements, dynamic grid
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: kinetic typography, moving background elements, dynamic grid layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kinetic Concrete style When UI elements Then shaking text, moving backgrounds, impact shadows

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kinetic Concrete UI When functional Then includes kinetic chat, power agents, energy stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Kinetic Concrete UI When copy Then uses power language: 'Power', 'Force', 'Impact', 'Momentum'
